requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack startup
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to configure a docker-compose.yml, so that the full stack can be started with a single command and observability is verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean checkout of the repository
When a developer runs `docker-compose up`
Then the backend and frontend containers start successfully.
Given the containers are running
When an HTTP GET request is made to the health-check endpoint
Then it returns an HTTP 200 OK status, confirming integration and QA requirements are met end-to-end.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to < 5 minutes

requirements: R1: Add UI functionality to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Add UI functionality to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system
When a user submits edited details via the UI
Then the frontend successfully invokes the PUT API endpoint and updates the display.
Given an existing material
When a user confirms deletion
Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes the item from the catalog view, with E2E tests validating these UI flows.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material removal time to < 30 seconds

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating a material and prompt them to log in.

slices.title: Enforce authentication for catalog access and material creation
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication on protected routes, so that restricted epidemiological protocols are protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then they are blocked and redirected to the login prompt.
Given an authenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog
Then they are granted access to view and manage materials, with integration tests asserting valid and invalid session handling.
